source_abilities.name: Earthen Wall
source_abilities.description:
Creates a barrier around self and all nearby party members that absorbs damage equivalent to a heal of 40,000 potency.
Duration: 10s
Cast and recast timer cannot be affected by status effects or gear attributes.
